name: Kurohime
source: The only child to successfully be born after Xavier impregnated many women during his previous revival. She has the power to break any seal, and will remain eternally young. She presently lives as a guest in the Shimazu house, and all four brothers adore her, having called her "Kuro-neechan" since they were kids.
